# Feature 2: cap on article list limit (GET /api/articles)

## Goal
Stop one request to GET /api/articles from returning more articles than the team rules allow.

## Rules this feature depends on
Values are not copied here. The Builder reads them from the source.

1. Maximum articles per request. Source: Okto Neuron, vault "team", answer to "What is the largest number of articles that GET /api/articles may return in one request?". Cited file: .marginalia/sources/3b59bc11b0f39812/policy-article-list-limit.md, bytes 0-144.
2. Over-maximum behaviour: a requested limit above the maximum is treated as the maximum, not rejected. Same Neuron answer and same cited file.
3. Default limit when no limit is given. Same Neuron answer and same cited file.

Neuron status was ok, finish_reason was stop, and vault_override_ignored named "team", the vault requested. I did not open the cited file directly. No conflicting source was seen in the citations.

## Current code (app/, read only)
- app/src/app/routes/article/article.controller.ts: GET /articles passes req.query straight to getArticles. No limit check here.
- app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts, getArticles(): take is Number(query.limit) with a fallback when the value is falsy. There is no maximum and no guard for negative or non-numeric input.
- GET /articles/feed uses getFeed() and a separate limit path. Out of scope unless the Builder is told otherwise.

## Scope
Change only the limit handling for GET /articles, so it follows rules 1 to 3.
